Leave us a Google review: https://g.page/r/CQhn52SlLBoeEBM/review
One click. Takes about 20 seconds.
Thanks for choosing Planet Apparel.
[OWNER SIGNATURE]

scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],

Your [PRODUCT] came out great. Quick thought while it's fresh: bandanas are how most people meet us, but if you can put a logo on it, we've probably made it. Shirts, hats, custom promo, all of it.

scripts.name: Cross-Sell Response
scripts.sentByRule: Cortney sends when a customer bites on the intro, within 1 business day.
scripts.bodyText:
Hi [FIRST NAME],

So nice to meet you. I'm Cortney, I run the promo and apparel side here. Thanks for the intro, Shara.

The fun part of my job is I get to work on just about anything you can put a logo on. But before I throw ideas at you, I'd love to learn about you. What's your world, and is something coming up, or is this just a fun branded idea you're playing with?

Whenever you're ready, tell me what you're picturing and I'll put numbers together. We've got your [PROJECT NAME] art on file, so setup's easy.

No pressure at all. Glad we got to make those bandanas for you.
scripts.firesWhen: Reply-triggered (no timer): fires only when the customer replies to the cross-sell intro; Cortney replies within 1 business day, in the intro thread.
scripts.notes: v4 2026-07-10: Holly rewrite (dictated live in session) - learn-about-you first, numbers second. Holly-approved verbatim - do not re-edit. Dictation 'Char' normalized to 'Shara'. CONDITIONAL: when the intro was Cortney's own ^xsellc she is already on the thread and has introduced herself - delete the whole first paragraph (So nice to meet you ... Thanks for the intro, Shara.). T1: call task for Cortney 2 weeks (14 days) after send unless replied.

Glad we got to be part of the [PROJECT NAME] run either way.

scripts.name: T1 Quality Check Call
scripts.sentByRule: Box owner calls (T1 only). Folds the cross-sell intro into the same call.
scripts.bodyText:
OPENER: "Hi [FIRST NAME], it's [PM] at Planet Apparel. Your [PROJECT NAME] should've landed. Did it come out the way you pictured?"
React like a person, name a real detail if you saw the order.
NOTE: they also received our QC email with the review button. If they mention it, great - do NOT push the review on the phone.
IF VOICEMAIL: totally fine, the email already carries the QC ask and the review button. One voicemail, no chase.
LOG IT: after every call, mark the Streak task DONE and add a comment on the box: CONNECTED / LEFT VOICEMAIL / WRONG NUMBER + one line. The system reads emails automatically but is blind to phones - your log is its eyes. Wrong number? Log it and move on - the email sequence continues automatically.
scripts.firesWhen: T1 supplement: personal call task +2 business days after the QC email (which sends to ALL tiers). Cross-sell is its own Week-2 touch, never folded into this call. Task on the Retention box.
scripts.notes: v2 2026-07-09: the call now SUPPLEMENTS the auto QC/review email (Round 9 P2) - it never replaces it. Email always sends to every tier; this call adds the personal layer for T1.

stages.name: NEW
stages.entryRule: A first paid order is marked Won/paid in Printavo, creating a box at NEW and flipping the customer to New Customer.
stages.exitRule: A 2nd paid order moves them to ACTIVE; 12 months with no 2nd order moves them to LOST.

stages.name: ACTIVE
stages.entryRule: They place a 2nd paid order (graduating from NEW) or recover from a save, and are within 1x their typical cadence.
stages.exitRule: Days since last order exceed 1.25x cadence (or an event customer misses their season-opening window) -> AT RISK.

stages.name: AT RISK
stages.entryRule: The band-updater flips them when they pass 1.25x-2x their normal cadence, or miss an expected season opening.
stages.exitRule: A new paid order returns them to ACTIVE; no response after Touch 2 (or >2x cadence) moves them to INACTIVE.
stages.northStarAnchor: North Star, Lifecycle Stage - AT RISK

stages.name: INACTIVE
stages.entryRule: The band-updater moves them here after a failed AT RISK touch and days past 2x cadence.
stages.exitRule: A reorder commitment moves them to REACTIVATED; 90 days with no response, or a hard no, moves them to LOST.

stages.name: REACTIVATED
stages.entryRule: A customer who was AT RISK or INACTIVE places a new order or makes a clear commitment; the PM moves them here manually.
stages.exitRule: 90 days post-reactivation on rhythm -> ACTIVE; going cold again -> AT RISK or INACTIVE.

stages.name: LOST
stages.entryRule: 12 months from NEW with no 2nd order, or 90 days in INACTIVE with no response, or a hard no from the customer.
